headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 16, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Francisco Alvarez leading the offense. Alvarez hit two home runs and drove in two runs in just three at-bats. The win marked a crucial moment for the Mets in their ongoing divisional battle.

Several key players have been sidelined due to injuries. Brad Keller, a right-handed pitcher for the Philadelphia Phillies, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow UCL tear, effective retroactive to July 13, 2026. Additionally, Tommy Troy of the Arizona Diamondbacks has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a sprained right AC joint, while Rob Zastryzny of the Milwaukee Brewers has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a left trapezius strain.

The Washington Nationals made a significant roster move, trading CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a notable trade, acquiring RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash from the Houston Astros in exchange for OF Jadyn Fielder.
